prose: Kotaku reports that hundreds of AI-decompiled or vibe-coded clones of games have appeared in recent weeks, ported to run in browsers, with some big titles playing surprisingly well: GTA: Vice City, Halo: Combat Evolved, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Skate 3 and more, decompiled and ported to the web seemingly overnight.
Basis: the Kotaku page was not fetched in this pass, so this rests on the headline and Techmeme's excerpt. The legal and preservation questions are presumably the story's core; read the original.
highlights: Hundreds of AI-decompiled game clones appeared in weeks
GTA: Vice City, Halo, Black Ops, Skate 3 among them
Ports run in browsers, some playing well
